usageNotes: Retrieves a single cluster-level firewall rule by its zero-based position index. Use this after listing rules (get_cluster_firewall_rules) to inspect a specific rule's full details before editing or deleting it. Requires Sys.Audit on the root path ('/'); the pos parameter is optional — omitting it returns rule at position 0.

examples.summary: Fetch the third cluster firewall rule (index 2)

tips: Rule positions are zero-based and shift when rules are inserted or deleted — always re-list before referencing a position in a subsequent write operation.
The 'action' field may be an ACCEPT/DROP/REJECT keyword or the name of a security group when the rule type is 'group'.
The 'enable' field is an integer (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled), not a boolean.
ipversion is derived automatically from source/dest addresses and is informational; you cannot set it directly.
